after_change.opt_in_variable_set_to_1: failed as designed: batch latency p95 8.083s exceeds 5.0s (host was noisier at that moment)

phase_timing_one_500_event_batch.method: existing projector/store have no per-phase timers for project_records, so cProfile was run from a scratch script (not committed) over the same 2000-event/4x500 run; profile overhead inflates absolute numbers (~4.8s unprofiled-comparable per batch vs 4.4s unprofiled)
phase_timing_one_500_event_batch.where_the_5s_goes: About two thirds of each batch (13.7 of 20.2 s profiled) is resolve_identity: ~900 calls, each opening a fresh PostgreSQL connection through ProjectionStore._connect_db (connection thread + connect + SET options + query); the single write transaction per batch is ~1.1 s and materializer rebuild ~0.2 s per batch. Roughly 4.5 ms of connection setup plus queries per resolve_identity call against a loopback docker Postgres.

host_contention_or_regression.verdict: Not host CPU contention and not a recent projector regression; a structural per-call connection cost that leaves almost no headroom under 5.0 s on this host.
reasoning: load average was 1.3-3.4 on 12 CPUs during all runs, process CPU 9.2 s over 20 s wall (the rest is waiting on Postgres/connects)
p95 is dominated by the last batch which is slower than batches 1-3 (4.3-4.9 s vs 5.7-6.4 s), so the p95 ceiling is set by whichever batch lands in a noisy interval

projection_store.py resolve_identity unchanged since 2026-11-17 and no capacity-relevant change in PR 8002; previous 2 failures and 3 of 4 of this task's observations sit at 5.2-5.7 s, i.e. the steady cost is ~4.4-4.9 s against a 5.0 s ceiling
host_contention_or_regression.limit: No historical per-batch baseline was available to prove absence of a regression; this is a judgment from code history and repeatability, not a bisect.

residual_finding_for_trade_journey_owner: ProjectionStore.resolve_identity opens one new PostgreSQL connection per call (about 900 per 2000-event run, via _bound_journey/_superseded_retry_journey). Reusing one connection per project_records batch (or batching identity lookups) would cut about two thirds of projection latency. This is a production performance finding, not hidden by this change; the section 14 ceilings remain the gate of the managed full-scale run.
